verdict.rationale: Azure documents headless automation directly. The Azure CLI is built for scripts as well as interactive use, runs in Docker containers, and offers JMESPath `--query` output shaping for scripted pipelines. The REST API docs explicitly cover unattended scripts in DevOps automation, and declarative IaC (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform) supports pipeline-driven deployment. A community user also notes that almost everything can be done from the command line. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI-pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines tasks), and documented non-interactive service-principal login for CLI runs in CI.
